title: Microsoft Purview: export DLP and label policy configurations as a ZIP file (Worldwide)
notes: claim 31: severity blocker on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
the verifier wrote "hold" but listed no blocker and fewer than three majors; the claims decide, so the page is not held
summary: Held because the impact rationale says only administrators can see the export option, but Microsoft does not document that access restriction. The export behaviour, UI paths, licensing background and rollout dates are otherwise supported.

claims.claim: Microsoft Purview adds an option to download existing DLP configurations and label policies, including schema, as a ZIP file.
claims.quote: This feature will allow users to export their existing DLP configurations and label policies, including schema, as a downloadable ZIP file.

claims.quote: 'Sign in to the Microsoft Purview portal > Solutions > Information Protection > Publishing policies.' Cited whats-new page: 'The Label policies page ... has a new Export policies option' and 'The Export to Zip selection'.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment
claims.claim: The export is a point-in-time snapshot of policy configurations in the current solution.
claims.quote: The Export to zip option on the policies page downloads a point-in-time snapshot of all your policy configurations as a ZIP file in XML format.

claims.claim: The downloaded ZIP contains the configuration in XML format.
claims.quote: Extract the ZIP file to access the XML configuration file.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The export captures full configuration details, including rules, conditions, actions, scoping and priority where relevant.
claims.quote: The export captures the full configuration details for every policy in the current solution at the moment of export, including rules, conditions, actions, scoping, and priority settings where relevant.

claims.claim: Label policies include their labels in the export.
claims.quote: For example, Label policies include the labels in the export, but not rules or conditions as they don't have any.

claims.claim: Label policies have no rules or conditions and therefore do not export any.
claims.quote: For example, Label policies include the labels in the export, but not rules or conditions as they don't have any.

claims.where: controls[1].note; What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment
claims.claim: The label-policy ZIP includes the policies and all sensitivity labels in the tenant.
claims.quote: The Export to Zip selection includes more detailed information about the policies and all sensitivity labels in your tenant.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The exported configuration is read-only and intended for reference.
claims.quote: The exported ZIP file is a read-only, point-in-time snapshot of your policy configuration. It's intended for reference only.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The ZIP cannot be imported back into a tenant to restore or create policies.
claims.quote: You can't import it back into your tenant to restore or create policies

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The snapshot does not automatically update after configuration changes.
claims.quote: it doesn't automatically update to reflect subsequent configuration changes.

claims.where: controls[0].note; summary; What's changing; Risk assessment
claims.claim: Individual policies cannot be selected; the ZIP exports all policies in the solution.
claims.quote: You can't select individual policies for export—the ZIP file always contains all policies.

claims.claim: Export to CSV exports only policies-table summary information such as policy name, status and last modified date.
claims.quote: The Export to CSV option exports only the summary information shown in the policies table, such as policy name, status, and last modified date.

claims.claim: Learn describes attaching the ZIP to a support ticket so engineers can review the complete configuration without a live troubleshooting session.
claims.quote: Attach the ZIP file to a support ticket so that support engineers can review your complete policy configuration without a live troubleshooting session.

claims.claim: Learn lists configuration backup for version control and change tracking as an export scenario.
claims.quote: Configuration backup — Save periodic snapshots of your policy configuration for version control and change tracking purposes.

claims.claim: Learn lists local PowerShell analysis of the extracted XML as an export scenario.
claims.quote: Configuration analysis — Extract the XML file and analyze your policies locally by using PowerShell or by uploading the file to Microsoft 365 Copilot.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Learn lists uploading the extracted XML to Microsoft 365 Copilot as an analysis option.
claims.quote: Configuration analysis — Extract the XML file and analyze your policies locally by using PowerShell or by uploading the file to Microsoft 365 Copilot.

claims.claim: Learn's what's-new page lists the DLP and sensitivity label publishing policy export as generally available in April 2026.
claims.quote: April 2026 > Shared capabilities: General availability (GA): Export policy configuration as a ZIP file containing a point-in-time snapshot of all policy configurations in XML format for DLP and sensitivity label publishing policies.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters
claims.claim: The export is user-opt-in: a person chooses the available export option rather than the feature exporting automatically.
claims.quote: If exporting is supported for that solution, the Export to zip option will be available. Select Export to zip.

claims.claim: Only administrators who open the DLP or label publishing policies pages see the export option.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Microsoft Purview DLP label policies Export to zip who can export administrators readers access permissions'; opened purview-policy-export, purview-permissions and dlp-create-deploy-policy. None states administrator-only visibility for this export.
claims.fix: Replace the impact rationale with: 'Low. The export option sits on the DLP and label publishing policies pages. Its output is read-only and cannot be imported to restore or create policies.' Do not assert administrator-only visibility while the export role is undocumented.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment; rationale: risk; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Taking the export does not change existing policies or users' content in the tenant.
claims.quote: The exported ZIP file is a read-only, point-in-time snapshot of your policy configuration. It's intended for reference only. You can't import it back into your tenant to restore or create policies

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The export is an option inside the licensed DLP and Information Protection solutions, with an included licensing model rather than a separately documented export entitlement.
claims.quote: Appropriate subscription licenses are required for customer use of online services. ... the administrator creating and managing Information Protection features must have the appropriate licenses

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The export page names no licence for Export to zip.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Purview" "Export to zip" license licensing pricing meter'; opened the full purview-policy-export page and the Purview service description. The export page gives scenarios, export steps and XML analysis without naming a licence.

claims.claim: The export page names no meter for Export to zip.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Purview" "Export to zip" license licensing pricing meter'; opened purview-policy-export, the service description and purview-billing-models. The export page names no meter, and the billing page does not identify policy ZIP exports as metered.

claims.claim: The export page names no prerequisite for Export to zip.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Purview Export to zip enable disable admin switch permissions roles license pricing DLP label policies export API PowerShell'; opened the full purview-policy-export page. It has no prerequisites section or named prerequisite.

claims.claim: A licence specific to the export option is not yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Purview" "Export to zip" license licensing pricing meter'; opened purview-policy-export, the Purview service description and purview-billing-models. They document solution licensing, not a separate policy ZIP export licence.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The service description lists Microsoft 365 E5/A5/G5/E3/A3/G3 and Business Premium among the licences for DLP for Exchange Online, SharePoint Online and OneDrive.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 E5/A5/G5/E3/A3/G3, Microsoft 365 Business Premium, SharePoint Online Plan 2, OneDrive for Business (Plan 2), Exchange Online Plan 2

claims.claim: Office 365 E5/A5/G5/E3/A3/G3 also provide rights for DLP for Exchange Online, SharePoint Online and OneDrive.
claims.quote: Which licenses provide the rights for a user to benefit from the service? ... Office 365 E5/A5/G5/E3/A3/G3

claims.claim: The service-description table marks Manual Sensitivity Labeling as included in Microsoft 365 E5/A5/G5/E3/A3/G3/F1/F3/Business Premium.
claims.quote: | Feature | Microsoft 365 E5/A5/G5/E3/A3/G3/F1/F3/Business Premium | ... | Manual Sensitivity Labeling | Included |

claims.claim: The same service-description section says sensitivity labeling requires Microsoft 365 E5 or Microsoft 365 Information Protection and Governance (IPG).
claims.quote: Sensitivity labeling, including automatic or policy-based labeling, requires a Microsoft 365 E5 license or Microsoft 365 Information Protection and Governance (IPG).

claims.claim: The administrator creating and managing Information Protection features must have the appropriate licences.
claims.quote: This means the administrator creating and managing Information Protection features must have the appropriate licenses for the following subscription plans to configure the functionality.

claims.claim: The standard Import-Clixml cmdlet can read the extracted exported XML for local analysis.
claims.quote: You can use the standard PowerShell Import-Clixml cmdlet to deserialize the exported XML file into PowerShell objects for local analysis.

claims.claim: Import-Clixml reads the file locally and does not connect to a service.
claims.quote: This cmdlet reads the file locally and doesn't connect to any service.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment; Scope; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: The export page does not state the role required to use Export to zip.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Purview" "Export to zip" permissions role enable disable'; opened purview-policy-export, purview-permissions and dlp-create-deploy-policy. The export page names no role; other pages do not specify the portal ZIP export role.

claims.claim: The DLP policy article lists role groups for creating and deploying policies.
claims.quote: The account you use to create and deploy policies must be a member of one of these role groups: Compliance administrator; Compliance data administrator; Information Protection; Information Protection Admin; Security administrator.

claims.claim: The DLP policy article does not say its create-and-deploy roles govern the portal ZIP export.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Microsoft Purview DLP label policies Export to zip who can export administrators readers access permissions'; read dlp-create-deploy-policy in full. It specifies create-and-deploy roles and granular access, but does not mention the ZIP export.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not document an automation operation equivalent to the DLP policies page's Export to zip option.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Purview" "Export to zip" API PowerShell DLP label policy'; opened purview-policy-export and Export-PurviewConfig. The cmdlet documents component diagnostic exports, not equivalence to the portal policy snapshot.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not document an automation operation equivalent to the label publishing policies page's Export to Zip option.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Purview" "Export to zip" API PowerShell DLP label policy'; opened create-sensitivity-labels, purview-policy-export and Export-PurviewConfig. MIPLabels diagnostic export is documented, but equivalence to the portal policy-and-label snapshot is not.

claims.claim: Export-PurviewConfig exists in Security & Compliance PowerShell.
claims.quote: This cmdlet is available only in Security & Compliance PowerShell.

claims.claim: Export-PurviewConfig returns Purview diagnostic configuration data as a compressed ZIP.
claims.quote: Use the Export-PurviewConfig cmdlet to export Microsoft Purview diagnostic configuration data for your organization. The exported data is returned as a compressed ZIP file (byte array) containing component-specific diagnostic information.

claims.claim: Export-PurviewConfig supports DLP and MIPLabels components.
claims.quote: The Components parameter specifies which Purview components to export diagnostic data for. Valid values are: ClassificationAndTextExtraction; DLM; DLP; MIPLabels.

claims.claim: Export-PurviewConfig requires assigned Security & Compliance permissions.
claims.quote: You need to be assigned permissions in the Security & Compliance before you can use this cmdlet.

claims.claim: The Export-PurviewConfig reference does not describe it as the portal's Export to zip or establish that the two ZIPs have identical content.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Purview" "Export to zip" API PowerShell DLP label policy'; read the full Export-PurviewConfig reference and purview-policy-export. The cmdlet reference describes diagnostic data and does not mention the portal option or promise matching contents.

claims.where: Open questions: audit activity; writer evidence
claims.claim: An audit activity specific to the portal's DLP and label policy ZIP export is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Purview policy configuration ZIP export audit log activities'; opened audit-log-activities and searched its full text for Export to zip, Export-PurviewConfig and export with policy/configuration. Results did not identify this portal export activity.
